verdict.rationale: IP India runs online e-filing, status-tracking and search services, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence covers only web portals (e-filing, Track Status, public search), and no command-line tool is documented anywhere in the pack. The llms.txt probe returned 404, which also shows no agent-oriented tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
